  • Method Details

    • renderTooltip

      public static void renderTooltip(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen gui, net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics guiGraphics, int x, int y, int width, int height, int mouseX, int mouseY, Supplier<List<net.minecraft.network.chat.Component>> linesSupplier, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.inventory.tooltip.TooltipComponent visualComponent)
      Render a tooltip if the mouse hovers over the given region. If no visual component is given, this is equivalent to GuiHelpers's tooltip rendering. Otherwise, the tooltip is rendered by vanilla, so that the visual component can be rendered below the tooltip lines. This must be called while rendering the foreground layer of the given gui, as the given position is expected to be relative to the gui.
      Parameters:
      gui - The gui to render in.
      guiGraphics - The gui graphics.
      x - The region X position, relative to the gui.
      y - The region Y position, relative to the gui.
      width - The region width.
      height - The region height.
      mouseX - The mouse X position.
      mouseY - The mouse Y position.
      linesSupplier - A supplier of the tooltip lines.
      visualComponent - An optional visual tooltip component.

    • isHovering

      public static boolean isHovering(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen gui, int x, int y, int width, int height, int mouseX, int mouseY)
      Check if the mouse hovers over the given region, which is when renderTooltip(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen, net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics, int, int, int, int, int, int, java.util.function.Supplier<java.util.List<net.minecraft.network.chat.Component>>, net.minecraft.world.inventory.tooltip.TooltipComponent) would show a tooltip for it.
      Parameters:
      gui - The gui that is being rendered in.
      x - The region X position, relative to the gui.
      y - The region Y position, relative to the gui.
      width - The region width.
      height - The region height.
      mouseX - The mouse X position.
      mouseY - The mouse Y position.
      Returns:
      If the mouse hovers over the region.
